description: This Java class defines the main entry point for the 'Things Service' component within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends a generic DittoService class, reads configuration, initializes the Actor system, and sets up routing through Akka actors.

classes.name: ThingsService
classes.description: Main class for starting and managing the lifecycle of the Eclipse Ditto 'Things' service. Handles configuration, actor system initialization, and service startup.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Static method that initializes and starts the ThingsService.

methods.name: getServiceSpecificConfig
methods.description: Overrides base method to provide service-specific configuration, using DittoThingsConfig.

methods.name: getMainRootActorProps
methods.description: Overrides base method to create Props for the main root actor, configuring it with the provided config and publisher/subscriber mediator.
